description: A woman wearing a red hijab and white shirt sits at a wooden table in a room covered with a black-and-white checkerboard pattern on the walls and floor, creating an optical illusion.
Close-up portrait of a young woman with long blonde hair wearing a red 'Team D' sports jersey, facing forward with a neutral expression against a plain gray background.
A masked burglar in a balaclava and gloves carrying a crowbar walks past a large glass window, his reflection visible; he wears a dark sweater, gray pants and brown shoes.
Smiling woman facing the camera with light brown hair pulled back, wearing a teal high-neck top and a dark navy blazer, photographed outdoors with a blurred leafy background.
A young barefoot child standing on sand wearing a winter hat, sunglasses, a zip-up hoodie and rolled-up cargo pants, casting a long shadow.
Several passengers in a subway car—some standing and holding poles, others seated—most looking at smartphones; colorful, mural-covered interior and metal poles visible.
A worker wearing bright orange high-visibility reflective clothing and gloves sweeping a wet pavement with a large broom; parked vehicles and pigeons are visible in the background.
Close-up portrait of a smiling baby partially submerged in water, wearing a leopard-print swimsuit, outdoors.
A pregnant woman wearing a fitted black turtleneck dress, sheer black tights and black high heels, standing against a white curved wall and gently holding her belly.

A group of pedestrians walking on a city street. Center foreground shows a man in a shiny black jacket holding a red suitcase; to his right a younger man in a dark puffer jacket carries an orange shopping bag. A bus and urban buildings are visible in the background.
Ornate Russian Orthodox church facade with colorful onion domes, gold cupolas, and detailed brick and stone arches.

A bearded man in camouflage military uniform and a padded tank-style helmet with headset, standing outdoors on a dirt road; he wears a blue armband and has tactical pouches on his vest with vehicles and leafless trees blurred in the background.
Extreme close-up of a human eye showing a golden-brown iris, dark pupil, long eyelashes, and detailed surrounding skin texture.
Young woman sitting at a windowed desk using a laptop displaying stock/financial charts; smartphone on the table showing green 'Buy' and red 'Sell' buttons, red mug nearby, visible arm tattoo.

A group of mourners dressed in black standing outdoors in a wooded area. A woman gently comforts a young girl holding a stuffed bear; other adults stand solemnly nearby, suggesting a funeral or memorial service.
Male runner mid-stride during a road race wearing a singlet and shorts with a race bib reading 'McClintock 194' and neon yellow running shoes.

Two adults standing close together in a crowd, both wearing red scarves and winter coats; they appear solemn and are clapping. The woman wears a beige coat and white beanie, the man wears a dark coat.
Smiling young male doctor wearing a white lab coat and a stethoscope around his neck, standing with arms crossed in a bright medical corridor/clinic interior.
Smiling middle-aged man in a dark suit and blue patterned tie, standing with arms crossed in an official-looking room with a U.S. flag and a government seal/flag visible in the background.
Family portrait with a woman in an astronaut suit holding a toddler, a man standing beside them holding another toddler; all posing against a plain white background.

Two young children sitting on grass: an older girl on the left wearing a pink tie-dye dress and a shell/beaded necklace, smiling, and a younger toddler on the right in a white top and colorful sandals making a playful/exasperated face while touching her ear.
Close-up portrait of an adult man with short brown hair and a slight smile, wearing a white t-shirt against a plain light gray background.
Magician and female assistant performing a stage illusion; assistant lies inside a metal box on a table while the magician in a yellow jacket kneels beside her, smiling.
Full-body portrait of a man in a dark suit and light striped tie walking along a tiled outdoor walkway beside a porch with potted plants and greenery in the background.

Two young women walking together on a city sidewalk, smiling and looking at a smartphone one of them is holding; they wear casual summer outfits (crop tops, skirt and jeans) and carry a handbag, with an illuminated pedestrian hand signal and urban background with graffiti and buildings.

Two boxers sparring in an indoor boxing ring — a blonde female in white gloves, black top, red-trim shorts and knee-high socks facing a male in black gear with brown gloves; both are mid-action near the ropes in a dimly lit gym.

Black-and-white photograph of a family seated around a dining table eating a meal. An adult man is on the right, an adult woman on the left, and a young child sits between them; plates of food, serving bowls, utensils, and a glass of water are on the table.

Four people in vintage gangster-style clothing seated around a red-and-white checkered table with plates of sausages; an older woman and two men at the table, and a man in a white shirt and suspenders smoking with a shoulder holster and rifle nearby.
Two adults sitting across from each other in a dim bar or café booth, both leaning on their hands and looking pensive or bored; the woman holds a glass on the table.
Extreme close-up of a human eye showing the iris and pupil — blue-green iris with brown flecks, visible eyelashes, sclera, and surrounding skin texture.
Elderly man in white clerical robes and a white skullcap, shown in profile with his hand on his chin in a contemplative pose; shallow depth-of-field outdoor background.

A group of men seated around a table in a casual restaurant, two men in the foreground eating burgers. Table holds a bottle of Coca-Cola, condiments (ketchup, mustard, A1 sauce), fries and napkins. Men wear dress shirts and ties; informal dining setting.

A bride in a white wedding gown stands in the center holding a bouquet, surrounded by six bridesmaids wearing matching light blue-gray floor-length dresses and holding white floral bouquets, posing outdoors on grass with trees in the background.

A man wearing sunglasses, a yellow-and-white striped polo shirt, white shorts, black socks and hiking boots sits on a rocky cliff overlooking a vast desert canyon and rugged rock formations in the background.

Two older men seated closely together in a crowded venue, smiling and laughing. Both wear casual dark-blue tops (one over a white polo), relaxed posture, foreground shows a sneaker; candid, friendly moment.

Black-and-white close-up photograph of a man in a suit and tie speaking into a microphone at a public gathering; he is gesturing with one hand and there are people and a protest sign visible in the background.

Three firefighters in protective gear and red helmets stand near a large, intense building fire with thick black smoke. A fire engine is parked to the right with multiple hoses laid out on the ground, and flames engulf debris and nearby vehicles.
Elderly woman with a colorful headscarf and blue floral blouse, smiling gently in an outdoor market setting.

Black-and-white vintage family portrait of two adults and four children posed in front of bookshelves; mother seated holding a young girl, father standing behind, children arranged around them, all wearing formal clothing.

A bartender wearing a white shirt and black bow tie pours liquid from a blue bottle into a jigger over metal cocktail shakers on a bar counter, with shelves of liquor bottles blurred in the background.
Woman wearing a red and gold embroidered traditional dress and headpiece, standing on a street during a public event or parade.
Three young women with long brown hair posed closely together, neutral expressions, wearing light-colored tops against a plain light background.
Sepia-toned vintage photograph of a young boy smiling while standing in front of a tall person wearing a shaggy fur animal costume and mask, posed outdoors against a brick wall.
A seated man in a suit at a conference table surrounded by several people who have placed hands on his shoulders and are bowing their heads in a prayerful or supportive gesture.
Vintage black-and-white photo of a woman and a shirtless man standing on a beach with a tall person wearing a shaggy polar bear costume between them.
Middle-aged man with a long, bushy gray beard threaded with small wooden beads, prominent eyebrows and a raised-eyebrow expression, wearing a faded dark t-shirt against a solid red background.

A man in a blue suit and red tie walks through a doorway escorted by multiple uniformed police officers and security personnel, with officers standing in the foreground and a dimly lit interior behind them.
Two young women wearing sports bras eating pizza at an outdoor cafe/table on a busy street.
Smiling adult man in a white t-shirt holding a tennis racket over his shoulder and leaning on the net on an outdoor clay tennis court.
A solitary flat-topped tree standing in a barren desert plain with rocky hills in the background under a clear blue sky.
